stem.text: A $200\,\text{cm}^{3}$ sample of water has an amount of oxygen gas dissolved in it.
This amount of oxygen gas has a volume of $6.00\,\text{cm}^{3}$ when measured at $1.00 \times 10^{5}\,\text{Pa}$ and $35\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.
What is the concentration of oxygen gas in the water? (You should assume that oxygen behaves as an ideal gas.)
